nom: ANUA Heartleaf Low pH Deep Cleansing Water

avis.texte: Attempted to use this for my mascara and couldn’t see clearly for hours. A complete fog over my eyes even after washing. My eyesight was so hazy, I couldn’t drive or see many colors. Just all grey. Terribly painful too. I must be allergic to something in it because my mouth goes numb everytime I use it. The fragrance seems to be the reason.

avis.titre: Long lasting use and great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: K-Beauty has been my new go to for skin regimen. It’s much more affordable and I’m getting some great results with my hormonal acne. This is just step one in my skincare cleansing routine. It helps get all of that dirt and gunk off of my face prior to going in with a foam wash. It’s good for makeup removal, but I would suggest an oil based cleanser first, then use this product after. My face is much softer when using this product and it’s not harsh on my already sensitive skin. It also lasts for months. I’ve had this bottle since moving into my apartment and that was about 2 months ago. You can’t go wrong with this product at this price.

This cleanses my face nice. It removed water resistant makeup well. I do not have sensitive eyes, but I found that it made my eyes burn a little. So, I would just avoid my eyes with this cleansing water. I like the size of this product.
I stand by Anu products. This deep cleanser is my go to every night. Removes any impurities and easily removes waterproof eye makeup.

This is my absolute favorite! The product is so light yet still cuts through the makeup and oil leaving my skin feeling clean and amazing. I have so many other products to try but I keep veering back to this. I highly recommend.
This make up remover very skin friendly and good for sensitive skin I like it . Very big bottle for long time

avis.titre: Daily toner - staple for start of skincare routine
avis.texte: Good size bottle so plenty for what you pay for. Also cleans well and doesn’t irritate my skin (not sensitive skin though so take this with a grain of salt if you do have it.) I’ve tried a few different toners and like this one more than others (better than Son & Park Beauty Water imho!) will definitely buy again when I run out.

Being new to the micellar water craze, I did not even know that was what I was ordering when I opted for this Heartleaf/Panthenol Low PH Deep Cleansing Water by Anua. The very first thing I noticed about this cleansing water is that it only contains 11 ingredients (not including water), and that I can pronounce every one of them. I'll pass on listing every bad ingredient that this formulation does not have, suffice to say that every ingredient in this cleansing water is both Earth friendly and people friendly. After using this micellar water for only a few days, I am hooked. It really cleans thoroughly, but is not harsh on the skin. Quite the opposite, after using this product my skin feels clean and very moisturized, as if I just applied a day cream. I love that there is no fragrance in this, nothing at all to irritate my sensitive skin. The cleaning agent (surfactant) used is very mild, and it does double duty, or actually triple duty because it also hydrates and smooths. For inquiring minds, the surfactant in this solution is polyglyceryl-4 caprate. While I appreciate that this solution does not need to be rinsed, my preference is to give it a quick rinse with tepid or even cool water. But it's nice to have for those times when our well water pump decides to stop working. Or even for a camping trip, the point being, that I'm sure the no rinse feature will come in handy. My skin is just loving this product because it's gentler then foaming cleansers I've used, and it's more

So…I do what I call…lazy girl skincare! I like a quick and simple routine so I use Micellar Water as opposed to like a foaming cleanser or balm. I'm always looking for new brands to try and this is one of those! So what I normally like about K-Beauty is that the ingredients are generally minimal and simple. For the most part, this includes pretty simple ingredients. There's just a couple that I am not familiar with. And while they aren't super limited, there is less than many other brands that I have used. So anyway, this does work as a standard micellar water at cleaning your face. However, I don't really wear much makeup so can't say how well it takes off things like waterproof mascara. And this bottle is BIG…so it will last you a long while! Ultimately, definitely wouldn't hesitate to order this again as well as recommend to others!

This is a fantastic miceller water, it gets rid of everything!! I had a heavy smokey eye, with waterproof liner (top, bottom, and waterline) applied this on a reusable cotton pad and it wiped off everything!! I was really impressed with how little I had to rub to remove everything too. No irritation on my eyes, and after using it did not leave any type of residue. I did also use this to clean up my liner, and it felt like nothing on my skin. No smell, no oiliness and no burning. Overall, this is a fantastic product! I did want to note that my cap on mine came broken, but the product itself was sealed and the cap still works. I do think that was a issue with how it arrived not the product.

I’ll start by saying I have sensitive skin and experienced no irritation with this. The bottle was much larger than I expected so that was a nice surprise! My skin felt absolutely squeaky clean after using this and a little went a long way. There was no prominent smell and it didn’t overly dry out my skin. It did feel tighter after so definitely moisturize after using. I thinks it’s also an affordable option and a decent size for the price. I am very happy with the performance of this! Definitely recommend!

Anua micellar water can be used in lieu of a cleanser when you want a quick cleanup, but it also can be used to easily help breakdown makeup and become part of a multi-step cleansing routine. Just put some on a soft cotton pad or face wipe and watch it do work. It smells light, fresh and is super nourishing on my skin.
Used this to take off my makeup and did a great job !!!easy to apply and doesn’t irritate my skin
